Produces: Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature tokens; Infinite landfall triggers
Start: Kodama of the East Tree (battlefield); Petrified Field (hand); Echoing Deeps (graveyard); Stone-Seeder Hierophant (battlefield); Retreat to Emeria (battlefield)
Prerequisites: Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
  You are able to play a land this turn.
Steps: Play Petrified Field.
  When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Retreat to Emeria trigger.
  Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
  Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
  Resolve the Retreat to Emeria trigger, creating a token.
  When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Petrified Field.
  When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Retreat to Emeria and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
  Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping Echoing Deeps.
  Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
  Resolve the Retreat to Emeria trigger, creating a token.
  When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
  When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Retreat to Emeria triggers.
  Repeat from step 4.

## Combo 3234-3293-3899-5413
Cards: Emeria Shepherd + World Shaper + Spawning Pit + Trenching Steed
Color identity: GW | Bracket: Exhibition | Popularity: 0 | Commander: legal
Produces: Infinite charge counters on a permanent; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite creature sacrifice triggers; Infinite death triggers; Infinite landfall triggers; Infinite self-mill; Return all nonland permanents from your graveyard to the battlefield
Start: Emeria Shepherd (battlefield); World Shaper (battlefield); Spawning Pit (battlefield); Trenching Steed (battlefield)
Prerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
Steps: Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing a land.
  Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
  Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing World Shaper.
  When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
  When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
  Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
  Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
  Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
  Repeat
Notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Color identity: GW | Bracket: Exhibition | Popularity: 0 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {1}
Produces: Infinite colored mana; Infinite proliferate; Infinite charge counters on a permanent
Start: Tromell, Seymour's Butler (battlefield: without summoning sickness); Pentad Prism (battlefield: with a charge counter on it); Gauntlets of Light (battlefield: attached to Tromell)
Prerequisites: You have had five nontoken creatures enter the battlefield under your control this turn.
Steps: Activate Tromell by paying {1} and tapping it, causing you to put at least five charge counters on Pentad Prism.
  Activate Pentad Prism five times by removing five charge counters from it, adding {4}{W}.
  Activate Gauntlets of Light by paying {2}{W}, untapping Tromell.
  Repeat.
